title: Chapter 2: Querying (features/02_querying)
description: Querying implemented with SQLite and the sqlite-vec extension underneath. The engine is completely invisible to callers: one query interface, with different query functions on one class and SQLite underneath, so callers never see which engine is running. Supersedes the old property-based filtering over in-memory objects from the former features/03_query_export chapter. Implementation of record: BOTSPY-c7795b (Local Store Initiative). Specs first: features/02_querying/*.feature.
right_now_summary: SQLite-backed querying is implemented, with Gherkin tests covering iteration, filters, and lazy results.
